verdict.rationale: Circle documents Agent Wallets that let an AI agent hold funds and transact autonomously within spending policies you define, with customizable spending controls and compliance guardrails. Programmatic wallet creation is available via APIs and the Circle CLI, and keys are secured with MPC or passkeys rather than raw private keys. Missing for 10: explicit scoped or per-agent key permissions, concrete documentation of the spending-limit and policy parameters (what an agent can move and how limits are enforced), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
